runs.title: Executive sales & margin
runs.userUtterance: Zeige das letzte abgeschlossene Quartal: Umsatz, Marge sowie Top-Produkte und Top-Kunden.

oracle.conclusion: Q2 revenue €12,480,000; gross margin 31.4%. Top product Atlas Drive; top customer Futura Retail.

runs.title: Quality investigation
runs.userUtterance: Untersuche den Ausschuss-Peak in Werk 3, Linie C, und prüfe Volumen sowie Liefercharge.

values.interpretation: Strong association with supplier batch SB-X17; causation is not established.

oracle.conclusion: Defect rate 8.6% versus 1.9% baseline at Werk 3/Linie C; 18200 units. Strong association with supplier batch SB-X17; causation is not established.

runs.title: Inventory stockout risk
runs.userUtterance: Zeige das knappste Material für Werk 2, Rotor-7, sortiert nach Reichweite, und vergleiche Bedarf mit bestätigtem Zulauf.

oracle.conclusion: Rotor-7 at Werk 2: 2.4 days coverage, demand 4200, confirmed supply 900; stockout risk.

runs.title: Maintenance downtime & MTBF
runs.userUtterance: Fokussiere Pressen-Ausfallzeit und MTBF im zweiten Quartal und öffne die Ereignisse.

oracle.conclusion: Press: 41.5 h downtime, 68 h MTBF, 6 events in Q2.

runs.title: Cross-domain demand comparison
runs.userUtterance: Vergleiche Atlas-Drive-Nachfrage mit Produktion und Bestand im zweiten Quartal. Keine Kausalbehauptung.

values.interpretation: Demand growth co-occurs with lower coverage; this is correlation, not proof of causation.

oracle.conclusion: Atlas Drive: demand +24%, production +9%, coverage 3.1 days. Demand growth co-occurs with lower coverage; this is correlation, not proof of causation.

values.interpretation: Strong association with supplier batch SB-X17; causation is not established.

oracle.conclusion: Defect rate 8.6% versus 1.9% baseline at Werk 3/Linie C; 18200 units. Strong association with supplier batch SB-X17; causation is not established.

runs.userUtterance: Filtere Atlas Drive; dieselbe Aktion kommt doppelt. Danach rückgängig.
